options.why: Placed the decimal point one place too far left after multiplying 46 by 3.
Multiplied 46 by 3 but did not restore the one decimal place from 4.6.

options.why: Multiplied 75 by 8 correctly but placed the decimal point one place too far left.
Multiplied 75 by 8 correctly but restored only one decimal place instead of two.
